tool.name: ParaFEM Diffusivity Field
tool.description: Compute temperature-dependent diffusivity field (.mat) and p124 .dat for diffusion solve

param.name: dat_file
param.label: Control data (.dat)
param.help: p123 or p124 .dat from BC generator. Mesh/partition parameters are extracted; diffusion params below override the solve.

param.name: temp_field
param.label: Temperature Field File
param.help: EnSight scalar (.ensi.NDTTR*) or .ini file from Extract IC tool

param.name: nstep
param.label: Number of timesteps
param.help: Use 1 with large dtim for steady-state; use many for transient.

param.name: dtim
param.label: Timestep size (s)
param.help: Large value (1e10) gives a single-step steady-state solution.

param.name: val0
param.label: Initial concentration (mol/m^3)
param.help: Initial condition for the diffusion field.

data.name: output_d
data.label: Modified mesh (.d) with per-element material IDs

data.name: output_dat
data.label: p124 control data (.dat) for diffusion solve

tool.help:
Computes temperature-dependent diffusivity for each mesh element using the Arrhenius relation:
D(T) = D0 * exp(-Ea / RT)
Outputs: 1. .mat: one material entry per element with kx=ky=kz=D(T_avg), rho=1, cp=1. 2. .d: mesh with each element's etype_pp set to its element ID for per-element lookup. 3. .dat: a complete p124 control file with np_types=nels and the specified diffusion parameters.
The .dat, .d, and .mat outputs are passed directly to the ParaFEM Transient Thermal Solver (gdps_transient_thermal) for the diffusion solve step.
